_doc: Read by scripts/offline/audit-gate.mjs in .github/workflows/dependency-audit.yml. Each entry accepts ONE advisory on ONE package until its expiry date; after that it blocks again. Add one only with a written reason and the decision that allowed it. Remove an entry once no audited lockfile (root, mcp-server, cli) matches it any more.

exceptions.reason: DoS while parsing form data from a remote functions `form`. Reckons.AI builds with adapter-static and has no server, no *.remote.ts file, no $app/server import and no remoteFunctions option (checked 2026-11-17), so the vulnerable code path does not run. Fixed only in @sveltejs/kit 3.2.0, which fails our build today (Dependabot #641).
exceptions.decided: MATT, 2026-11-17 (AskUserQuestion): 'Named exception + migrate' — exception for this advisory id only, and the SvelteKit 3 migration starts on its own branch.

exceptions.reason: Private `query.batch` remote functions could collide. Reckons.AI defines no remote functions (static build; checked 2026-11-17). Fixed only in @sveltejs/kit 3.2.0.

adapter-node crashes on malformed pathnames rewritten by `reroute`. Reckons.AI builds with adapter-static and has no reroute hook, so no adapter-node server exists to crash (checked 2026-11-17). @sveltejs/kit 2.70.4 fixes it, but on 2026-11-17 2.70.4 failed three e2e tests on PR #647 (generated-assets-story 'reload resumes one job' 3 of 3 tries, the 'Shelly queues a chain' test, and story-walk 'the step link survives a reload') while 2.70.3 passed the same suite on #648 and #642 that day; kit stays pinned at 2.70.3 until the SvelteKit 3 migration (#649).
exceptions.decided: MATT, 2026-11-17 (AskUserQuestion): 'Pin 2.70.3 + 2 more exceptions', chosen over skipping to SvelteKit 3 (#649) and over keeping 2.70.4 and fixing the tests.
exceptions.removeWhen: @sveltejs/kit is on 2.70.4+ with the e2e suite green, or on 3.2.0+

exceptions.reason: A protocol-relative module import during SERVER-SIDE route resolution. The shipped site is static files with no server, so production cannot reach it. It CAN apply to a local development server (npm run dev) if a crafted URL reaches that server; that is the remaining exposure until the upgrade. @sveltejs/kit 2.70.4 fixes it, but on 2026-11-17 2.70.4 failed three e2e tests on PR #647 (generated-assets-story 'reload resumes one job' 3 of 3 tries, the 'Shelly queues a chain' test, and story-walk 'the step link survives a reload') while 2.70.3 passed the same suite on #648 and #642 that day; kit stays pinned at 2.70.3 until the SvelteKit 3 migration (#649).
exceptions.decided: MATT, 2026-11-17 (AskUserQuestion): 'Pin 2.70.3 + 2 more exceptions', chosen over skipping to SvelteKit 3 (#649) and over keeping 2.70.4 and fixing the tests.
exceptions.removeWhen: @sveltejs/kit is on 2.70.4+ with the e2e suite green, or on 3.2.0+

exceptions.reason: ReDoS when an attacker supplies a glob such as +(*). picomatch is a development-only dependency in the root and mcp-server lockfiles (through vite, vitest, svelte-check, tinyglobby and the PWA build tooling), it is not in the shipped app, our code never calls it, and the only patterns it parses come from our own build and test configuration (checked 2026-11-17). No patched version exists: 4.0.7, the latest, is affected.
exceptions.decided: MATT, 2026-11-17 (AskUserQuestion): 'Dated exception until a fix', chosen over no longer blocking on development-only dependencies and over waiting for a picomatch fix.
exceptions.removeWhen: picomatch publishes a fixed version and the lockfiles move to it
